SELECT A.seq, A.id, A.name, A.comment, TO_CHAR(A.reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date, (SELECT name FROM file WHERE seq = A.file_seq) AS file_name FROM member A WHERE A.use_yn = 'Y'
AND A.id LIKE '%' || #{id} || '%'
AND A.name LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
ORDER BY A.reg_date DESC
SELECT A.*, (SELECT name FROM file WHERE seq = A.file_seq) AS file_name FROM member A WHERE A.id = #{id}
